notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35554896/9caece2e836fd10e23a88ea2062cf987747d6816.png

Eldritch University is coming out this June, with an intended release date of June 12th. The expected price of the game will be $5.99 USD or the converted equivalent.

Do you know someone who may like a horror/romance visual novel? Be sure to let them know!

notes.title: Eldritch University Demo Updated and Tentative Release Window
notes.notes:
Now that the development for the game seems to be winding down toward a final build, I decided to put together an update for the demo of Eldritch University. It covers pretty much the same content as before, but now includes the BGM tracks and all of the script tweaks from the most recent build.

There is also a potential release window, now that I'm closer to a final build. With the primary focus of the remaining development being the final revision pass on Acts 2 and 3 and finishing the bonus stories, I'd like to aim for a summer release. My current plan is to try a June 2020 release window, but I'm not going to commit to a set date quite yet.

At any rate, I hope people enjoy the revised demo and look forward to the full release!
